text:
amanda: customer reports streaming response stops after ~30s idle, then client reconnects and gets 401. happening behind ALB -> Cloudflare worker chain. they pasted curl output and server logs.

kai: do we have their repro steps + headers? sounds like auth not preserved on reconnect.

amanda: repro they gave: `curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -N https://api.redwood.test/v1/stream`  — it returns chunks, then stops; client auto-reconnects and server logs `401 unauthorized` for the resumed request.

mike: tried a repro in staging. I see initial stream 200 + chunked; after ~35s of no bytes, ALB sends a probe then connection half-closes. client reconnect uses same socket reuse path at the edge, but Authorization header is missing on the resumed request.

amanda: customer says their edge has a token refresh middleware that rewrites auth on new connections. maybe CF worker or their SDK strips header on pooled connections.

support_bot: incident_created: #INC-2026-141 - streaming-auth-resume - assigned to eng-runtime.

dev_infra: note: some proxies (Cloudflare Workers/Edge) drop or rewrite Authorization when doing request replays or when http/2 stream multiplexing happens. also buffering can cause downstream to only see final chunk and delay probes.

mike: tcpdump from origin shows client FIN after ALB probe then new SYN from CF. origin sees new conn with no Authorization. logs: `GET /v1/stream 401 - missing auth` followed by previous session `200` with trailing chunk.

kai: two working hypotheses: 1) CF worker or ALB is reissuing the request without original headers on reconnect/replay. 2) client/SDK doesn't reattach token on reconnect. Which side is customer on?

customer: we run a custom SDK that does automatic reconnect; we confirmed it reuses an internal pool and doesn't re-send auth on resume. token is short-lived (1m).

amanda: thanks. short-term workaround: increase token TTL OR set client to always include Authorization on reconnect. also instruct customer to set `Cache-Control: no-transform` and `Connection: keep-alive` at edge to avoid intermediate replay.

dev_infra: additional mitigation: on server accept, if we detect a resumed session missing auth but matching earlier session id/cookie, respond with `449 Retry With` pointing to re-auth flow or include `WWW-Authenticate` with hint. engineering follow-up: eng-runtime should add logging for "resumed_without_auth" with original session id to trace matches.

kai: filing internal task: ENG-RUNTIME #4824 — detect auth-missing reconnects, capture original root request id, surface in console. tagging @eng-runtime.

mike: for the customer's immediate fix I pushed a config on their dedicated LB that reduces idle probe aggressiveness and disables request replay on reconnection. they reported streaming resumed consistently for 6+ attempts.

amanda: I'll update the support ticket with repro steps, workarounds, and request for dev follow-up. cc @customer for next steps. :thumbsup:

customer: confirmed workaround works. thanks for quick triage!
